identity: Stillgrave keeps every grave labelled and every bone accounted for; this season the uncalled dead wander its furrows and a very confused gang is robbing the wrong graves.

quests.title: Please Leave the Residents Buried
quests.text: Small Plague Boars spend their days rooting through the {name:dead_furrows} {dir_of:stillgrave:dead_furrows}, scattering people I took considerable trouble to bury. Kill eight; their yellow names mean they will leave you alone until you strike. Someone is also stealing bones, but let us begin with the offenders who cannot carry a sack.
quests.lesson: Yellow names are neutral single pulls; keep the meat for the cook.

quests.title: Mind the New Fingers
quests.text: Make a Wooden Axe and a Wooden Pickaxe and bring them to me for inspection. I will give you a pair in return; even a second life deserves a proper start. Mind your fingers while you work, especially any you have only recently acquired.
quests.lesson: Basic grid tools; handed-in tools are consumed, the reward replaces them.

quests.title: The Fire Still Eats
quests.text: The fire beneath my brine pot has gone out, and glaring at it has achieved very little. Bring me five logs from any tree outside Stillgrave's warded ground; logs, please, not planks. Death excuses a great many appetites, but apparently a fire's is not among them.
quests.lesson: Any log counts; planks do not. Protected town plants cannot be cut.

quests.title: Teeth in the Furrows
quests.text: At night the Large Grave Rats take over the {name:dead_furrows}, and the sound of their teeth carries all the way to my chair. Kill eight after dark. They bite at anything they see, so look before you step; I would rather not carve your name this early.
quests.lesson: The night roster of one area; red names attack on sight.

quests.title: Leave the Headstones
quests.text: Take your wooden pick to plain rock in the hills outside town, then make a Stone Axe and a Stone Pickaxe. Bring me both and I will return a pair after inspection. If the rock has a name and two dates on it, find another rock.
quests.lesson: Tool progression; check the rock's required pick tier.

quests.title: A Little Warmth, Professionally
quests.text: Bring me five Coal Lumps from the rock outside Stillgrave; you can mine while you wait for nightfall. The public oven by my table takes coal in the fuel slot and raw food in the cooking slot. Mixing those up is how we discovered a meal even the dead would send back.
quests.lesson: Gather while waiting for night; the public oven is in town.

quests.title: A Sack Ought to Hold Something
quests.text: Our shroud sacks have begun returning their contents to the floor. Bring me two Rat Fur Patches from the Large Grave Rats in the {name:dead_furrows}; anything you saved from your night hunt will do. Keep the spares for your armour enchants, and let me worry about dressing the storage.
quests.lesson: Ordinary loot saved from an earlier hunt can be handed in.

quests.title: No Names to Call Them By
quests.text: Braindead Zombies wander the {name:ashfields}, which lies {zone_area:ashfields}, raised without anyone to remember who they were. I have read the burial rolls aloud; not one turned its head. Lay eight to rest, by day or night. The blight soil shelters them from the sun, so waiting for dawn is no kindness.
quests.lesson: Red names are aggressive; zombies on blight dirt never burn in daylight. They walk among the neutral boars by day and the rats by night.

quests.title: Mourning Is Hungry Work
quests.text: Bring me ten Raw Meat from the boars and rats around Stillgrave; whatever you kept from your hunts is welcome. A mourner may insist they cannot face a meal, but I still leave a bowl within reach. You shall have some cooked meat for the road, too; I dislike sending anyone away empty.
quests.lesson: Meat from earlier hunts counts; cooking is optional.

quests.title: An Introduction in the Furnace
quests.text: Mine copper and tin, smelt them, and bring me three Copper Bars and three Tin Bars. I will give you a Dual Furnace so you can begin making bronze. The metals must share a fire; happily, they get along better than most families at a reading of the will.
quests.lesson: Ores, smelting and the dual furnace for alloys.

quests.title: The Moor Changes Tenants
quests.text: Watch the {name:blightmoor}, which lies {zone_area:blightmoor}, at dusk: the grazing stops, and then the squealing begins. Kill eight Aggressive Grave Rats there after dark; they attack on sight. The Young Gaunt Stags graze there by day, and I have no complaint against them to add to your duties.
quests.lesson: Aggressive hunters at night next to neutral grazers by day.

quests.title: Broth and Loose Ends
quests.text: For once, my shopping can be done in daylight. Bring me two Crab Legs from the Small Crabs on the {name:saltbones} {dir_of:stillgrave:saltbones}, and one Fine Sinew from the Young Gaunt Stags on the {name:blightmoor} by day. I have a broth to finish and brine sacks to tie shut; separate tasks, despite what you may have heard about my cooking.
quests.lesson: Two daytime drop requests that share one outing.

quests.title: Something to Take With You
quests.text: Use your Dual Furnace to alloy three Bronze Bars and bring them to me. There is a Bronze Pickaxe waiting for you, for the harder rock beyond Stillgrave. I cannot go along to see how you fare, but I can at least see you properly equipped.
quests.lesson: Alloying in the dual furnace; a better pick tier.

quests.title: Borrow Has Had Long Enough
quests.text: Our missing bones have led us to the {name:robbers_camp} {dir_from_giver:robbers_camp}, where {name:grave_robber_chief} has been treating the graves as a lending library. Kill six Confused Grave Robbers and their chief. Confusion might excuse digging the wrong hole once; arriving with sacks suggests a settled intention.
quests.lesson: A camp of aggressive humanoids and a named leader with a fixed spot.

quests.title: Older Graves, Deeper Water
quests.text: Listen: for once, that is only the wind among the stones. Follow the road to Mournfen Village and speak with Mordec Silt; the graves in his care are older than ours, and the water is rising around them. Come back when you can, preferably on your own feet.
quests.lesson: Travel handoff to the home zone.

quests.title: Bounty: A Census With Teeth
quests.text: The Monstrous Grave Rats in the {name:deadlands}, which lies {zone_area:deadlands}, have outgrown both their burrows and my patience. Kill six after dark and report back. I can offer this work again twenty minutes after you hand it in; the rats have declined to observe a longer interval.
quests.lesson: Optional repeatable tail of the hunt line.
